name: Mang Larry's Isawan
address: Beside Kalayaan Residence Hall, UP Diliman, QC
blurb: Legendary isaw and BBQ grilled to order — the after-class tambayan of Diliman students.

name: Rodic's Diner
address: UP Shopping Center, UP Diliman, QC
blurb: Old-school diner famous for its tapsilog — cheap, filling and perfect before a long lab.

name: Pino Restaurant
address: Maginhawa St area, Teachers Village, QC
blurb: Creative takes on Filipino comfort food — a good pick for barkada celebrations after finals.

name: Café Inggo 1587
blurb: Cozy café with local coffee and pastries — bring your laptop and grind out that capstone.

name: Common Folk Coffee Bar
blurb: Minimalist coffee bar with solid espresso and quiet corners for group study sessions.

name: Olivia's Café
blurb: Homey café with pasta, rice meals and cakes — chill spot for catching up with friends.

name: UP Town Center food strip
blurb: Rows of restaurants in one stop — milk tea, ramen, chicken and more when the group can't decide.

name: Ayala Malls Vertis North food court
address: North Ave cor. Mindanao Ave, QC
blurb: Air-conditioned food court with lots of choices — easy meet-up spot by the MRT North Ave station.

name: Cubao Expo
blurb: Artsy courtyard of indie cafés, bars and thrift shops — the weekend hangout after a long sem.

name: Lemuria
blurb: Elegant garden restaurant for special occasions — save up for grad dinner with the family.
